scope: Independent static review and fixture-only capture/numerical verification. No runtime data, broker, credentials, worker lifecycle or original registered source changes.

resolved_findings.finding: Cached imported numerical module could replace code whose on-disk bytes were SHA-verified.
resolved_findings.resolution: Parent changed v2 loader to compile/exec exactly verified bytes into a fresh ModuleType; cached module substitution test passes.

resolved_findings.finding: Resealed capture validation did not repeat fixed output/availability identity or monotonic per-pair observed clocks.
resolved_findings.resolution: Parent added fixed identity, inert flags, monotonic clocks and bounded source validation; adverse tests pass.

resolved_findings.finding: Shared frozen datetime parser truncates sub-microsecond fractions, potentially accepting minute+1ns as an exact minute.
resolved_findings.resolution: New v2-only wrapper checks source byte hashes and all raw timestamp columns before calling frozen parser; every nonzero fraction is rejected, while zero nanoseconds and equivalent +02:00 minute offsets pass.

temporal_findings: Every supervised training sample requires actual timestamps for the entire t-60m through t+60m interval, including exact H1 target. Missing feature, target or intermediate minutes exclude the affected row.

Training targets use price at t+3600 minus price at t, not next sixty available rows. Candle close/label maturity is start+60; allowed training target start is at most latest captured reference start, hence target maturity is at most reference+60.

Graph peer factors require every shared minute in the 61-close feature window; base/quote sign orientation is preserved. Only EURUSD target path must exist, since peers are features, not future labels.
State model resets at latest EURUSD gap and uses at most256 consecutive prices. The weekend jump is never treated as a one-minute return.

Input capture observes each stable byte snapshot now; source observations precede final capture, and computation completion cannot precede capture. Previously retained Friday labels are not claimed available historically.
Each derived input field is recomputed from retained byte evidence during validation; resealing altered derived fields does not bypass validation.
limitations: This verifies implementation and causal timestamp handling, not predictive accuracy, economic edge, calibration or trading readiness.
At least61 consecutive shared current closes and unchanged family training minima are still required; missing recent bars may still cause explicit abstention.
Only last1024 real rows per pair are retained, so adequate older training segments are not guaranteed.
Graph factors preserve the legacy per-pair pip units; they are not normalized currency returns. This is documented research model behavior, not proof of useful cross-currency inference.
Pooled normalization uses currently observed volatility for historical fit rows. No future outcome is used, but this remains a modeling choice requiring prospective evaluation.
